meta.description: Standalone deployment map. This project is 100% self-hosted: no SaaS licensing server, no telemetry backbone. Every path below is a placeholder that the buyer or CI fills with their own URLs/credentials.

live_preview._note: The AI agent compiles each generated site and stages a live preview. The Express API proxies those previews behind /api/ai/preview/:slug.
live_preview.stage_preview_command:
· Option A (Docker): docker compose up --build -d
· Option B (Node):  cd backend && npm run dev  +  npm run dev

agent_preview_host.route: GET /api/ai/preview/:slug — first preview every generated run

live_preview.privacy_note: PREVIEW_URL subdomains are temporary staging artifacts, never production traffic.

github_1_click_push._note: Connect the local workspace to a Git repository, then one push publishes it.
steps: git add . && git commit -m "chore: initial turnkey deployment"
github_1_click_push.secrets_policy: Ensure backend/.env, .env.local and any *.env with real secrets are git-ignored before pushing.

frontend.route_config: Vercel/Netlify SPA rewrites: every path → /index.html (present in vercel.json / _redirects if needed).

database.schema_init: Sequelize syncs tables on first boot (development) or via `node backend/scripts/apply-indexes.js` in production.

backend.websocket_note: Socket.io needs sticky sessions or a single-instance backend in the free tier; Railway/Render handle this on their default single-replica plan.

storage_and_extra.uploads: Backed by backend/uploads (ephemeral on PaaS) — mount a disk (Railway volume) or swap to Cloudinary (CLOUDINARY_* keys are already wired).
storage_and_extra.redis_optional: If REDIS_URL is absent the app transparently falls back to an in-memory cache — compatible with Render free tier.

workspace_to_repo_links._note: Replace placeholders with the buyer's repo and cloud dashboards.
local_first_boot: docker compose up --build -d   (or npm run dev:all)
Finish the Setup Wizard at http://localhost:5173

quality_gates.static: node --check on every backend file · ESLint on frontend (npm run lint)
quality_gates.tests: npm test (Vitest) · npm run test:backend (Jest 12 suites) · npm run test:e2e (Playwright)
quality_gates.build: npm run build — production bundle must succeed
quality_gates.security: secrets only in env files · inputs validated (express-validator/zod) · CORS whitelist · rate limits on auth/AI
quality_gates.performance: route-level code-splitting · hash-cached static assets · SWR caching (5 min staleTime)
quality_gates.a11y: WCAG 2.1 AA landmarks · keyboard navigation · prefers-reduced-motion · dark mode
